title: santisukia kerrii
intro: Santisukia kerrii, commonly known as the Thai Angelica, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Santisukia kerrii include anti-bacterial and anti-viral activities, making it effective in treating infections. The bioactive constituents of Santisukia kerrii include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
